/sections/0/blocks/0/markdown.source: 这项工作的关键研究判断，是把天然免疫过程拆成可以分辨作用环节的证据问题，再问哪些结构在简化后仍保留功能。仅看到“能切割”的最终结果，不足以知道引导、识别和执行分别由什么条件承担。
/sections/0/blocks/0/markdown.english: The key research judgment is to decompose a natural immune process into evidence questions that distinguish functional steps, then ask which structures retain function after simplification. A final result showing only that cleavage occurs is not enough to identify the conditions responsible for guidance, recognition and execution separately.

/sections/1/blocks/0/markdown.source: P01 从机制分解进入：先重构组分关系，再分离识别与切割，最后探索简化。P02 从工具目标进入：希望降低引导设计负担，因而需要反查哪些相互作用不能丢。作者明说了嵌合设计的结构理由；完整项目起点与全部试错仍未知。
/sections/1/blocks/0/markdown.english: P01 starts by decomposing the mechanism: reconstruct component relationships, separate recognition from cleavage, then explore simplification. P02 starts from a tool goal: reduce the burden of guide design, then work backward to identify interactions that cannot be lost. The authors explicitly state the structural rationale for the chimeric design; the complete project starting point and all trial and error remain unknown.

/sections/2/blocks/0/markdown.source: N01 的问题是让阴性结果有解释力。若正常体系本身没有读出，缺组分与测量失败无法区分；若恢复候选组分后功能出现，还要继续检查它改变了哪个环节。
/sections/2/blocks/0/markdown.english: N01 asks how to make a negative result interpretable. If the working system itself produces no readout, a missing component cannot be distinguished from measurement failure; if function appears after restoring a candidate component, the affected step still needs investigation.

/sections/2/blocks/1/markdown.source: N02 用独立读出拆开识别与切割。结合改变与结合不变但切割改变，会指向不同下一步。论文正文描述了这种区分，但本案例没有独立读取对应补充原始图。
/sections/2/blocks/1/markdown.english: N02 uses an independent readout to separate recognition and cleavage. Changed binding and unchanged binding with changed cleavage point to different next steps. The main text describes this distinction, but this case did not independently read the corresponding original supplementary figure.

/sections/2/blocks/2/markdown.source: N03 把简化变成可证伪的设计问题：先明确保留哪些结构，再比较不同简化版本和不同目标。某个设计失效不必意味着方向无用，也可能说明删去了必要相互作用。
/sections/2/blocks/2/markdown.english: N03 makes simplification a falsifiable design question: specify which structures to retain, then compare simplified versions and different targets. Failure of one design need not invalidate the direction; it may indicate that a necessary interaction was removed.

/sections/3/blocks/0/markdown.source: 较短嵌合设计效率不足是正文报告的结果；作者曾经试过多少版本、是否先为应用而做机制，都不能从中推出。继续维持双组分、改变结构或延后工具化在不同证据条件下都可能合理。失败的价值在于区分功能条件，不能仅以成败排列故事。
/sections/3/blocks/0/markdown.english: The main text reports insufficient efficiency for a shorter chimeric design; it does not establish how many versions the authors tried or whether they pursued the mechanism first for an application. Keeping two components, changing the structure or postponing tool development may all be reasonable under different evidence conditions. Failure is valuable when it distinguishes functional conditions, not merely when it orders a success-or-failure narrative.

/sections/4/title.english: Converging from exploration to a paper

/sections/4/blocks/0/markdown.source: 核心证据链把组分依赖、中间环节与功能保留连起来。多靶点体外测试为可编程性增加支持；细胞内编辑、其他物种和更广条件需要各自的证据。收束时应把已实现能力与未来用途分开，不让后来的成功倒灌进早期论证。
/sections/4/blocks/0/markdown.english: The central evidence chain connects component dependence, intermediate steps and preservation of function. Multiple-target in vitro tests add support for programmability; intracellular editing, other species and broader conditions each require their own evidence. Separate demonstrated capabilities from future uses so later successes do not retroactively enter the early argument.

/sections/5/blocks/0/markdown.source: 可以迁移的是“让阴性结果可解释”“用中间读出定位作用环节”“按功能约束简化”。这些判断在其他体系也有启发，但前提是对照可靠、测量能区分过程，且简化没有同时改变无法追踪的因素。
/sections/5/blocks/0/markdown.english: Transferable judgments include making negative results interpretable, using intermediate readouts to locate an effect, and simplifying under functional constraints. These can be useful in other systems if controls are reliable, measurements distinguish processes, and simplification does not simultaneously change untraceable factors.
